info.title: la-liquid
info.description: Command line tool that validates Liquid maps and runs them exactly like the Azure Logic Apps Standard Liquid action. Runs locally and in Azure DevOps pipelines.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Validate and run Liquid maps exactly like the Azure Logic Apps Standard Liquid action (DotLiquid 2.0.361, verified against workflow extension bundle 1.170.91).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate Liquid maps against the Logic Apps Liquid engine.

options.name: --map
options.description: A Liquid map, or a folder with Liquid maps (searched recursively for *.liquid).

options.name: --input
options.description: Optional input message. When given, the map is also rendered and the output is validated. Only valid with a single map.

options.name: --kind
options.description: The transform kind of the Liquid action: JsonToJson, JsonToText, XmlToJson or XmlToText. When omitted, it is inferred from the input and output file extensions.

options.name: --warnings-as-errors
options.description: Treat warnings as errors. [default: False]

options.name: --culture
options.description: The culture of the Logic Apps host. DotLiquid uses it to parse decimal literals and text, and to format numbers and dates. [default: en-US]

options.name: --time-zone
options.description: The time zone of the Logic Apps host: UTC in Azure, unless the app setting WEBSITE_TIME_ZONE is set. Accepts Windows and IANA ids. 'local' uses the time zone of this machine.

options.name: --no-lint
options.description: Skip the static checks and only report what the Logic Apps engine itself reports. [default: False]

options.name: --no-deviations
options.description: Skip the detection of filters that behave differently from Shopify Liquid (LQ1xx warnings). [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: How findings are written: pretty (readable, the default, also in pipelines), msbuild (one line per finding, for the Visual Studio error list and the VS Code $msCompile problem matcher) or json. [default: Pretty]

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: How much the pretty format shows per finding: minimal (one line), normal (location, values and fix) or detailed (also why). [default: Normal]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Write no colors. Colors are also off when the NO_COLOR environment variable is set, or when the output is redirected outside a pipeline. [default: False]

commands.name: transform
commands.description: Validate a Liquid map, run it with an input message and write the output.

options.name: --map
options.description: The Liquid map.

options.name: --input

options.name: --output
options.description: The output file. Only written when there are no errors.

options.name: --raw
options.description: Write the rendered text exactly as DotLiquid produced it. By default JSON output is written indented, as Logic Apps shows it. [default: False]

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run a suite of Liquid map tests with expected outputs. --culture and --time-zone override the suite file.

options.name: --suite
options.description: The test suite file (JSON). Paths in it are relative to the file.

options.name: --junit
options.description: Write a JUnit XML report to this path, for the Azure DevOps PublishTestResults task or a GitHub test reporter.

options.name: --update-expected
options.description: Write the actual outputs to the expected output files instead of comparing. Review the changes before committing them. [default: False]

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain a diagnostic code: what it means, an example and how to fix it.

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Write no colors. [default: False]

arguments.name: CODE
arguments.description: The code to explain, for example LQ102. Without a code, all codes are listed.
